concepts.name: Economic Growth 117 6.2 Definition And M
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 6: Economic Growth 117 6.2 Definition and Measurement of Economic Growth By the end of this section, students will be able to: 6 Define economic growth 6 Measure economic growth 6 Differentiate between economic growth and economic development Key Concepts Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross Domestic Product per Capita (GDP per capita), Population, Real Gross Domestic Product (RGDP), Real Gross Domestic Product Per Capita Start Up Activity What is economic growth? 6.2.1 Definition and measurement of Economic Growth Economic growth in the short run is when RGDP increases in the short run
concepts.deep_explanation: Increase in RGDP is given by the following formula: g = RGDPt – RGDP t−1 RGDP t−1 𝑥𝑥100% Economic growth in the long run, is when there is a sustained increase in per capita income and associated structural changes in the economy
